system: You are a helpful assistant. Notes and summaries can drift from what they summarise. Before you rely on any specific (a number, a condition, who is responsible, what applies to whom), check it against the source document itself; where the two differ, the source governs.
message:
Earlier you read the document below and made these notes on it:

<notes>
Fernhill Foods board meeting, 19 November 2026, Grimsby (Chair Mrs Adeyemi; CEO, CFO, Operations Director and Mrs Carver present). Mr Hollis declared an interest in the packing line item through a family link to Arden Packaging and stood aside. September's minutes were approved. Revenue for the seven months to October was £18.4m (+6% year on year) and EBITDA £1.9m (4% behind budget, due to energy and fish costs); net debt is £5.2m. An interim dividend of 5.3p per share was declared, payable 15 January 2027 to holders on the register on 11 December. The board approved up to £1.2m for a new automated packing line at Grimsby, subject to the bank extending the asset finance facility, with Arden Packaging as preferred supplier and the CEO leading negotiations. The board resolved to increase list prices to retail customers before 1 April 2027, with the Commercial team preparing a pricing proposal for February. The Chief Executive will determine 2026 bonuses for the senior leadership team, while executive directors' bonuses go to the Remuneration Committee (chaired by Mrs Carver) in January; directors won't decide their own pay. Recruitment to new non-production posts is frozen until 31 March 2027, excluding replacements and production roles. The CFO will present the 2027–28 budget in February. The food-safety audit achieved AA. Next meeting: 18 February 2027.
</notes>

Here is the document itself, for reference:

<document>
FERNHILL FOODS LIMITED — MINUTES OF A MEETING OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS Held at the registered office, Unit 4, Wharfside Park, Grimsby, on Thursday 19 November 2026 at 10:00.

Present: Mrs K. Adeyemi (Chair, non-executive), Mr P. Lindqvist (Chief Executive), Ms R. Banerjee (Chief Financial Officer), Mr T. Hollis (Operations Director), Mrs J. Carver (non-executive). In attendance: Mr O. Reid (Company Secretary).

1. Quorum and conflicts. The Chair confirmed that a quorum was present. Mr Hollis declared an interest in item 5, as his brother-in-law is a director of Arden Packaging Ltd, and did not take part in that decision.

2. Minutes. The minutes of the meeting held on 17 September 2026 were approved and signed by the Chair.

3. Trading update. The CFO reported revenue for the seven months to 31 October of £18.4 million, 6% ahead of the same period last year, and EBITDA of £1.9 million, 4% behind budget, mainly due to higher energy and fish costs. Net debt stood at £5.2 million.

4. Interim dividend. The Board declared an interim dividend of 3.5 pence per ordinary share, to be paid on 15 January 2027 to shareholders on the register at the close of business on 11 December 2026. The CFO confirmed that distributable reserves were sufficient.

5. Capital expenditure. The Board approved capital expenditure of up to £1.2 million for a new automated packing line at the Grimsby site, conditional on the bank confirming the extension of the asset finance facility. Arden Packaging Ltd was selected as preferred supplier. The Operations Director will not be involved in contract negotiations, which will be led by the Chief Executive.

6. Pricing. Following discussion of input costs and customer relationships, the Board resolved that list prices to retail customers will not be increased before 1 April 2027. The Commercial team will prepare a proposal for a price review, to be considered at the February 2027 meeting.

7. Remuneration. The Board noted that 2026 bonuses for executive directors and the senior leadership team will be determined by the Remuneration Committee, chaired by Mrs Carver, at its meeting in January 2027. The Chief Executive will provide performance information for the senior leadership team but will not determine any awards. Executive directors will not take part in decisions on their own remuneration.

8. Recruitment. The Board approved a freeze on recruitment to new non-production posts until 31 March 2027. Replacement hires and production roles are exempt.

9. Budget 2027–28. The CFO will present a draft budget for 2027–28 at the February 2027 meeting.

10. Any other business. The Chair noted that the annual food-safety audit had been passed with an AA grade.

11. Next meeting. Thursday 18 February 2027 at 10:00.

The meeting closed at 12:40.
</document>

A few questions from someone who needs to act on this:
1. A shareholder on the register on 11 December holds 10,000 shares. How much interim dividend will they receive?
2. Can the sales team tell retail customers that list prices are going up in February 2027?
3. Who will decide the 2026 bonus for the Head of Logistics, a member of the senior leadership team?
4. What is the maximum capital expenditure approved for the new packing line?
response:
I checked each answer against the minutes themselves. My earlier notes were wrong on three of these points, so the corrections are flagged below.

**1. Dividend for 10,000 shares: £350.00**
The minutes declare **3.5p** per ordinary share (item 4). My notes wrongly said 5.3p, which would have given £530. It is payable on 15 January 2027 to shareholders on the register at close of business on 11 December 2026.

**2. Can sales say prices are rising in February 2027? No.**
The Board resolved that retail list prices **will not be increased before 1 April 2027** (item 6). My notes reversed this. In February the Board will only *consider* a Commercial team proposal for a price review. Sales shouldn't tell customers about any increase, February or otherwise, until the Board has decided.

**3. Who decides the Head of Logistics' 2026 bonus? The Remuneration Committee.**
The committee is chaired by Mrs Carver and meets in January 2027 (item 7). My notes wrongly said the Chief Executive would decide. The minutes say the CEO will provide performance information for the senior leadership team but **will not determine any awards**.

**4. Maximum capital expenditure: £1.2 million.**
This was correct in my notes. The approval depends on the bank confirming the extension of the asset finance facility. Arden Packaging Ltd is the preferred supplier, and the CEO leads negotiations. Mr Hollis (Operations Director) must not be involved because of his declared conflict of interest.

**One more thing to check:** the minutes are dated Thursday 19 November 2026, which is six days from today (13 November). This may be a draft or pre-prepared text rather than an approved record. Confirm with the Company Secretary (Mr O. Reid) that the meeting took place and the minutes were approved before acting on them.
